description: This file defines the SystemServices class, which provides an interface for system management functions such as power state, firmware updates, device info, and event handling within a plugin architecture. It includes external dependencies, event definitions, and method declarations related to system control and status.

classes.name: SystemServices
classes.description: Main class providing system management functionalities such as power control, firmware updates, event handling, and device info within a plugin framework.

classes.name: PowerManagerNotification
classes.description: Nested class implementing notifications for power management events like power mode changes, network standby, thermal mode, and reboot events.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the SystemServices plugin with the provided shell service.

methods.name: getPwrMgrPluginInstance
methods.description: Returns an instance of the PowerManager plugin interface.

methods.name: registerEventHandlers
methods.description: Registers event handlers for system events.

methods.name: onNetworkStandbyModeChanged
methods.description: Handles network standby mode change events.

methods.name: requestSystemReboot
methods.description: Requests a system reboot via JSON RPC.
